description: Send a REAL signed test delivery to a registered endpoint and return what the endpoint answered — status code, response body, and the exact X-Volanea-Signature header sent. This is how you prove the signature-verification code you wrote actually verifies, rather than assuming it does. Creates a delivery row, so it also shows up in the endpoint's delivery log.

eventName.description: Event name to simulate, e.g. "email.delivered" (default) or "email.bounced".

name: volanea_test_webhook_delivery

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

responseStatus.description: Null when nothing ever connected — then the URL is wrong, not the signature.

verdict.description: What actually happened, derived from the outcome rather than assumed.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
